# AB'S Dental & Aesthetics

> Dental, skin and hair clinic in Brodipet, Guntur, Andhra Pradesh, India. Led by Dr. Sk Anusha Begum (BDS, PGDM, FCMMP, FFA-UK). Invisalign certified.

Address: 2/13, Bank of India Complex, Brodipet, Guntur, Andhra Pradesh 522002
Phone: +91 93470 62933, +91 90300 44555
Email: absdental69@gmail.com
Website: https://absdental.in

## Services
- Dental: implants, Invisalign and braces, root canal treatment, crowns and bridges, gum treatment, kids dentistry, smile design, teeth whitening, laser dentistry
- Skin: acne and scar treatment, pigmentation, anti-aging, chemical peels, laser skin treatments, HydraFacial, PRP therapy
- Hair: hair fall treatment, PRP hair therapy, hair transplant, scalp treatments
